title: Musche — Your music. Your time.
composer: Original score created for the Musche launch film
key: B minor opening, D major resolution

sections.feel: Intimate piano identity, warm pad, gradual rhythmic pickup
sections.motion: One deliberate hero gesture at zero. Answer on 1.2 and 1.8. Open wider at 4.8; anticipatory swell 8.45–9.6.

sections.feel: First rhythmic lift: bass, crisp kick, restrained clap, flowing arpeggio
sections.motion: Task pool assembly lands 9.6; secondary transforms 12.0, 14.4, 16.8. Small gestures every 0.6, staggered details every 0.3.

sections.feel: Full groove and melodic return, stereo plucks provide detail
sections.motion: Calendar reveal lands 19.2; drag and resize landings at 21.6, 24.0 and 26.4. Choreograph the movement before each landing.

sections.feel: Peak: melody lifts an octave, percussion becomes more animated
sections.motion: Broadest camera move lands 28.8. Track/feature reveals 31.2, 33.6, 36.0; stereo detail can drive micro motion.

sections.feel: Percussion withdraws, room to breathe and reveal the whole product
sections.motion: Full workspace lockup at 38.4; gentle pullback and heading at 40.8; anticipate brand landing from 42.3.

sections.feel: Resolved D major-nine piano cadence, final two melodic answers and a soft tail
sections.motion: Brand/logo must land at 43.2. Tagline appears on 44.4; URL may settle on 45.0. Hold, then let the ending breathe.

recommendedVisualCadence: Land major changes on bar accents. Start movement 0.3–0.6 seconds before the accent; follow through over the next 0.3 seconds. Avoid changing shots on every beat.
